answer: In PoA, each challenge commits to a future drand threshold-BLS beacon pulse; its hash, combined with a commit-reveal salt, determines the task instance and scoring seed. Because the pulse remains unpredictable until quorum signatures arrive, sybil swarms cannot precompute, cache, or offline-farm valid answers across identities. A pearl, copper, or tide label is merely metadata and cannot influence the beacon or bias eligibility.
